CWE-20.name: Improper Input Validation
CWE-20.remediation: Validate input against an allowlist of expected values, types and lengths before use.

CWE-22.name: Path Traversal
CWE-22.remediation: Resolve the path and confirm it stays inside the intended directory; reject traversal sequences.

CWE-78.name: OS Command Injection
CWE-78.remediation: Avoid shelling out. If unavoidable, pass arguments as a list and never build a command string from input.

CWE-79.name: Cross-site Scripting
CWE-79.remediation: Encode output for the context it lands in (HTML body, attribute, JS, URL). Prefer textContent over innerHTML.

CWE-89.name: SQL Injection
CWE-89.remediation: Use parameterised queries. Never concatenate user input into SQL.

CWE-200.name: Exposure of Sensitive Information
CWE-200.remediation: Remove sensitive values from responses, errors and logs; return generic error messages.

CWE-209.name: Information Exposure Through an Error Message
CWE-209.remediation: Return a generic error to the client and log details server-side only.

CWE-284.name: Improper Access Control
CWE-284.remediation: Enforce authorisation server-side on every request, not just in the UI.

CWE-287.name: Improper Authentication
CWE-287.remediation: Use a vetted authentication library; enforce MFA and correct session invalidation.

CWE-352.name: Cross-Site Request Forgery
CWE-352.remediation: Require an unpredictable per-session token on state-changing requests; set SameSite cookies.

CWE-434.name: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type
CWE-434.remediation: Allowlist extensions and content types, store outside the web root, and never execute uploads.

CWE-611.name: XML External Entity Reference
CWE-611.remediation: Disable external entity and DTD processing in the XML parser.

CWE-639.name: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key
CWE-639.remediation: Check the authenticated user owns the referenced object on every request (IDOR).

CWE-798.name: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
CWE-798.remediation: Move secrets to a secrets manager and rotate anything that was committed.

CWE-918.name: Server-Side Request Forgery
CWE-918.remediation: Allowlist destination hosts and refuse private, loopback and link-local addresses.

CWE-1236.name: Improper Neutralization of Formula Elements in a CSV File
CWE-1236.remediation: Prefix cells beginning with = + - @ with a single quote before export.
